translations.web: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will fill the souls of the priests abundantly, and will fill My people with My goodness,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith Jehovah.
